From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Model slate & perf links — pilot handoff and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the items I promised: recommended model slate, verified perf links (TPS / p50-p99 latency), a lightweight prompt set to validate quality, and an initial mutual action plan for pilot kickoff.

High-level recommended slate for Arcadia MVP (in order of preference for balance of cost/quality/latency):
- redwood-alpaca-13b-q4 (recommended): good quality on instruction-following tasks and ~2.4k TPS per GPU for our trace mix; quantized v2 to reduce cost.
- vicuna-13b-8k-q4: higher quality on dialog turns but ~1.6k TPS for same load; useful if you need better multi-turn coherence.
- redwood-instruct-7b-8k (fast lane): lower cost, ~4k TPS, slightly lower correctness on domain-specific prompts — good for conversational fallback.

Attached: redwood-verified-profiles.pdf (profiles with p50/p90/p95/p99 latency at our standard test load) and a short Arcadia MVP mapping (arcadia-mvp-map.xlsx) that aligns the slate to your three feature lanes.

Benchmarks and prompt pack: I uploaded a trace + prompt-set to the shared folder (link below). The CSV contains TPS numbers and percentile latencies for the sample prompts you shared.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which two models you want in the pilot slate (primary + fallback).
2) We provision a small Dedicated slot for a 2-week pilot and push the prompt pack as an eval harness.
3) Joint QA pass on the deck; we’ll wire a simple telemetry slice for quality regressions (precision/recall on the seed prompts).

If helpful, Ben can loop in our ops runbook for SLA targets and Grace can coordinate procurement requirements.

Links:
- HubSpot opportunity: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/ARC-2025-0421
- Shared bench folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Arcadia-benchmarks
- Raw traces (internal): s3://redwood-benchmarks/arcadia/20250512/trace-pack.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to lock picks.

Best,
Jonas Weber

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Jonas / Grace —

Quick internal note to help answer Samantha's asks:
- p95 for redwood-alpaca-13b-q4 at 1k concurrent (their mix): ~210 ms (p50 ~28 ms, p90 ~95 ms). Numbers derived from the trace-pack in the shared folder.
- Cost delta: redwood-alpaca-13b-q4 quantized v2 is about 1.9x the cost of redwood-instruct-7b per token for the same throughput. If we run an autoscale policy with instance packing, effective unit cost narrows.

Quality/regression recommendations (because Arcadia flagged hallucination risk on policy prompts):
- Baseline: run an eval harness using the provided prompt set (we already included 120 seed prompts covering policy edge cases).
- Alerting thresholds: raise a regression alert if F1 on the seed set drops >5% vs baseline or if hallucination rate (false positive assertions) increases by >3 percentage points over a 24h window.
- Guardrails: enable prefix KV caching and a short constrained reranker for policy queries (we have a light reranker config in the runbook).

Ops / pilot setup: I recommend starting with the 13b quantized primary + 7b as fallback. For procurement, we should propose a 3-month reserved pilot with opt-out at 30 days.

Happy to draft the SOW language for the pilot if you want — will need procurement contact details.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Short answers + concrete next steps below.

Answers
- p95 latency @ 1k concurrent for redwood-alpaca-13b-q4: ~210 ms (we measured with your trace; see s3 CSV).
- Cost delta vs redwood-instruct-7b: ~1.9x per token on quantized 13b; for 1k concurrent traffic with instance packing you should expect ~1.2x effective delta after utilization.
- Recommended alerting thresholds for regression:
  • Quality regression (F1 drop on seed set) > 5% over baseline -> page 1 (investigate).
  • Hallucination rate increase > 3 percentage points over a 24h window -> page 2 / on-call.

Pilot and paperwork
- Pilot slate we recommend (please confirm): primary = redwood-alpaca-13b-q4, fallback = redwood-instruct-7b-8k.
- Proposed pilot length & terms: 3-month reserved pilot, 30-day exit option. We’ll draft an SOW and send to procurement this week.
- Kickoff: block a 30-minute ops handoff (runbook, telemetry, alerting thresholds) — suggested slots May 20/21.

Links & artifacts (again):
- Redwood-verified profiles (p50/p90/p95/p99): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Arcadia-benchmarks
- Raw trace CSV (detailed TPS / latency by prompt): s3://redwood-benchmarks/arcadia/20250512/trace-pack.csv
- Pilot scope doc (draft SOW will be attached in the next email).

Next steps (owner):
- Samantha: confirm primary/fallback choice and whether procurement wants a draft SOW this week (owner: Samantha).
- Jonas: draft SOW and send to procurement, schedule ops handoff (owner: Jonas).
- Ben: prepare runbook snippet for hallucination detection and reranker config (owner: Ben).

If that works I’ll send the SOW and calendar invites.

Best,
